name: Controlled Traffic Expansion Step
decisionRules: approve_tiny_traffic_expansion maps to one reversible traffic action only.
share_one_private_link allows one private link and at most one invited person.
invite_tiny_watchlist allows one private channel and at most three invited people.
continue_monitoring maps to continue_observation with zero new invites.
hold_for_fix maps to create_fix_list with zero new invites and no private link.
pause_sales maps to pause_checkout_and_review with zero new invites, no private link and checkout disabled or not shared.
the tool records redacted evidence only; it never publishes, emails, posts or opens checkout automatically.
